summary: Alaunos Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing completion of its acquisition of privately held Velaris Therapeutics via a two-step reverse triangular merger executed on October 13, 2026, with Velaris stockholders receiving 105,286 Series B and 33,054 Series C non-voting convertible preferred shares, each convertible into 1,000 common shares. The deal is structured as a tax-free reorganization, with Velaris options assumed and adjusted by the exchange ratio. The filing also covers officer/director changes, charter amendments, and unregistered equity sales. Watch post-close ownership split, preferred conversion overhang, and Nasdaq compliance dynamics.
